criteria.text: Users can export a report as CSV
Export button in the report view
Exports are only visible to their owner
Export storage bucket exists in production

criteria.deferred: Needs a rendering library decision; separate epic

tasks.title: Add ExportJob model and migration
tasks.summary: Introduce the ExportJob model that tracks export requests and their status. Other export tasks build on it.
acceptance: Migration applies and rolls back cleanly
Model tests cover every status transition

tasks.title: Provision the export storage bucket
tasks.summary: Create the production bucket for export files and add its name to the deployment secrets.
acceptance: EXPORT_BUCKET is set in production and staging secrets

tasks.title: CSV export endpoint
tasks.summary: POST /reports/:id/exports starts a CSV export; GET /exports/:id returns status and a download link.
acceptance: Owner can create and download a CSV export

tasks.title: Export button in the report view
tasks.summary: Add an Export CSV button that starts an export and shows progress until the download is ready.
acceptance: Button starts an export and offers the download when done
